ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious HH.EXE Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects a suspicious execution of a Microsoft HTML Help (HH.exe)

sequences.query: ((process_original_file_name = "HH\.exe" OR process_path = RGX("\\\\hh\\\.exe$")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.application.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Temp\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Content\\\.Outlook\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Downloads\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Users\\\\Public\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Windows\\\\Temp\\\\.*")))
